newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins track US Treasuries Friday rally.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins track US Treasuries Friday rally.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose on Monday, tracking Friday's overnight rally in U.S. Treasuries, and dealers said buying was seen both in Russia and the West with the rise steadied by periodical profit-taking.

"Russian banks started buying in the morning as they saw higher levels than they did on Friday," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Sergei Kovzharov said. "The West supported the trend but the move is weakened by profit-taking."
"The West seems quite optimistic about U.S. Treasuries, and buying was very active," another Russian bank dealer said.

Kovzharov said prices were likely to stabilise in the current ranges until the latter part of the week when May U.S. retail sales and producer prices will be released on Thursday and Friday respectively.
MinFins, like other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news which would suggest a change in U.S. interest rates and consequently affect U.S. Treasury bond prices.
